source.title: City of Somerville FY2026 Budget Book

meta.note: Somerville’s FY2026 approved General Fund. Water, sewer, and the pool and field are separate enterprise funds, excluded here. The nine non-school function lines are exact from the budget book and sum to $267.4M; schools is shown as the approved total minus those, matching the city’s ~$112M school figure. The Council’s voted appropriation order was $362.9M (it leaves out state assessments and reserves).
facts: Property taxes carry about 74% of the budget — $280.7M of revenue, versus 15% from state aid.
Schools got the biggest FY2026 boost — about $8M more — and have grown 33%+ over four budgets.
Somerville holds a AAA bond rating, and FY2026 funds the new Assembly Square fire station.
